verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor (APU), and a built-in, user-facing AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks is not an axis for silicon. The evidence describes SDKs, runtimes and GAIA, a framework for building local agents. Those are developer building blocks that run on the chip, not an assistant built into the product, so the exception for shipping the capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
